principle: Keep only active departments visible. Archive completed legacy chats by default; delete only clearly disposable chats after retirement gates pass.

projects.name: BannerlordAI — 00 FRONT OFFICE
projects.purpose: Primary user-facing hub, daily plan, roadmap, whole-office status, chat registry, retirement queue.
projects.visible_chat_policy: One active Front chat at a time plus at most one next-Front handoff chat during rotation.

projects.name: BannerlordAI — 10 CODER DESK
projects.visible_chat_policy: One clocked-in Coder chat at a time. Retire it after terminal packet + Analyzer intake.

projects.name: BannerlordAI — 20 ANALYZER DESK
projects.purpose: One semantic evidence-review packet at a time; policies, lessons, acceptance gates.
projects.visible_chat_policy: One clocked-in Analyzer chat at a time. Retire after Front intake.

projects.name: BannerlordAI — 40 RESEARCH LIBRARY
projects.purpose: Durable research conversations that remain useful for deeper study and source interpretation.
projects.visible_chat_policy: Keep only durable research chats; no routine execution logs.

projects.name: BannerlordAI — 99 INBOX / REVIEW
projects.purpose: Temporary quarantine for any BannerlordAI chat Front Office has not classified or verified yet.
projects.visible_chat_policy: No execution from this Project. Front classifies each chat into Front/Coder/Analyzer/Research or verified archive retirement.

supervisor.reason: Supervisor is a local deterministic platform/system log, not a standing conversational department. It surfaces only exceptions to Front.

archive_default: Archive completed legacy engineering/canon chats after brain coverage + downstream review. Archived chats remain searchable.
delete_default: Delete only disposable/support/test chats when SAFE_TO_DELETE is verified. User performs final UI action.
cross_project_memory: Do not depend on individual Project history for operational continuity. HandoffV3/runtime + Mem layered brain are authoritative cross-project context.
cleanup_success: 00 Front contains only active Front chat(s); 10 Coder and 20 Analyzer are empty until launch; 40 Research contains only durable research chats; 99 Inbox is empty; verified legacy chats are archived.
